     1→# CLAUDE.md
     2→
     3→This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
     4→
     5→## Project Overview
     6→
     7→GoFi is a Go implementation of a music download tool, originally for Deezer but expanding to support multiple services including Spotify. It allows users to search and download music from these platforms through a command-line interface.
     8→
     9→## Build Commands
    10→
    11→```bash
    12→# Build the new CLI with Spotify support
    13→make build-cli
    14→
    15→# Build and install locally
    16→make install                # Install to /usr/local/bin
    17→make install PREFIX=$HOME/.local  # Install to custom directory
    18→make install-dev           # Create symlink for development
    19→
    20→# Build the legacy CLI (Deezer only)
    21→make build
    22→
    23→# Build all binaries
    24→make build-all
    25→
    26→# Run tests
    27→make test
    28→
    29→# Clean build artifacts
    30→make clean
    31→
    32→# Uninstall
    33→make uninstall
    34→
    35→# Build with version injection
    36→go build -ldflags "-X github.com/d-fi/GoFi/cmd/gofi/cmd.version=$(git describe --tags --always)" -o gofi ./cmd/gofi
    37→```
    38→
    39→## Installation Methods
    40→
    41→### For End Users
    42→
    43→```bash
    44→# One-liner install (macOS/Linux)
    45→curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d-fi/GoFi/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
    46→
    47→# One-liner install (Windows PowerShell)
    48→iwr -useb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d-fi/GoFi/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
    49→```
    50→
    51→### Installation Scripts
    52→
    53→- `scripts/install.sh`: Cross-platform bash script that detects OS/arch and downloads appropriate binary
    54→- `scripts/install.ps1`: PowerShell script for Windows installation with PATH management
    55→
    56→## Usage Examples
    57→
    58→```bash
    59→# Authenticate with Deezer (automatic browser cookie detection)
    60→gofi auth deezer
    61→
    62→# Authenticate with Spotify (required before using Spotify features)
    63→gofi auth spotify
    64→
    65→# Download a Spotify track and convert to FLAC
    66→gofi -q 9 download https://open.spotify.com/track/2YarjDYjBJuH63dUIh9OWv
    67→
    68→# Download a Spotify album to a specific directory
    69→gofi -o ~/Music/Downloads -q 3 download https://open.spotify.com/album/1DFixLWuPkv3KT3TnV35m3
    70→
    71→# Download a Spotify playlist in FLAC quality to a specific directory
    72→gofi -o ~/Music/Playlists -q 9 download https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DXcBWIGoYBM5M
    73→
    74→# Download an album with 5 concurrent downloads
    75→gofi -c 5 download https://www.deezer.com/album/302127
    76→
    77→# Download a playlist with only 2 concurrent downloads to be gentle on the API
    78→gofi -c 2 download https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DXcBWIGoYBM5M
    79→
    80→# Download from Deezer URL (no Spotify auth needed)
    81→gofi -q 9 download https://www.deezer.com/track/3135556
    82→
    83→# Check version
    84→gofi --version
    85→```
    86→
    87→## Code Architecture
    88→
    89→### Core Components
    90→
    91→1. **API Clients**: Service-specific API clients for fetching music data
    92→   - Deezer: `api/api.go`
    93→   - Spotify: `internal/services/spotify/spotify.go`
    94→   - Service Matching: `api/spotify_deezer_match.go` matches content between services
    95→
    96→2. **Authentication**:
    97→   - Deezer: 
    98→     - Automatic browser cookie detection: `internal/auth/browser_cookies.go`
    99→     - Supports Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and Arc browsers
   100→     - ARL helper functions: `internal/auth/arl_helper.go`
   101→     - CLI command: `cmd/gofi/cmd/auth_deezer.go`
   102→     - No longer requires manual DEEZER_ARL environment variable
   103→   - Spotify: 
   104→     - OAuth2 flow in `internal/services/spotify/auth.go`
   105→     - Stores tokens in `~/.config/gofi/spotify_token.json`
   106→     - CLI command: `cmd/gofi/cmd/auth_spotify.go`
   107→
   108→3. **Download Engine**: `download/download.go` handles the actual download of music files
   109→   - Concurrent downloads for albums/playlists (configurable 1-10 threads)
   110→   - Quality selection (FLAC, MP3 320kbps, MP3 128kbps)
   111→   - File existence checking to avoid re-downloads
   112→   - Improved error handling with retry logic
   113→
   114→4. **Metadata Management**: Adds appropriate metadata to downloaded files
   115→   - ID3 tags for MP3: `metadata/id3_tag.go`
   116→   - FLAC metadata: `metadata/flac_meta.go`
   117→   - Album cover art: `metadata/album_cover.go`
   118→
   119→5. **CLI Interface**:
   120→   - Legacy flag-based CLI: `cmd/main.go` (Deezer only)
   121→   - New Cobra-based CLI: `cmd/gofi/cmd/` (includes Spotify support)
   122→   - Improved download handler: `cmd/gofi/cmd/download_handler_improved.go`
   123→   - Version support with automatic injection during build
   124→
   125→6. **User Interface**: Beautiful terminal output
   126→   - Display manager: `internal/ui/display.go`
   127→   - Custom progress bars: `internal/ui/simple_progress.go`
   128→   - Color-coded output using `github.com/fatih/color`
   129→   - Icons and visual feedback for better UX
   130→
   131→### Data Flow
   132→
   133→#### For Spotify URLs:
   134→1. User provides a Spotify URL
   135→2. URL parsing (`internal/utils/urlparser.go`) identifies the content type (track, album, playlist)
   136→3. Spotify API fetches metadata through OAuth2 authentication
   137→4. The Spotify content is matched to equivalent Deezer content (`api/spotify_deezer_match.go`)
   138→5. Deezer API is used to download the matched tracks
   139→6. Metadata is added to downloaded files
   140→7. Files are saved according to the format: `<artist> - <track>.<ext>`
   141→
   142→#### For Deezer URLs:
   143→1. User provides a Deezer URL
   144→2. URL parsing (`internal/utils/urlparser.go`) identifies the content type (track, album, playlist)
   145→3. Deezer API fetches content directly (no Spotify auth needed)
   146→4. Content is downloaded using the Deezer API
   147→5. Metadata is added to downloaded files
   148→6. Files are saved according to the format: `<artist> - <track>.<ext>`
   149→
   150→## Configuration
   151→
   152→The application accepts configuration through:
   153→1. Command-line flags
   154→2. Environment variables in a `.env` file
   155→3. JSON configuration file
   156→
   157→Main environment variables:
   158→
   159→Authentication:
   160→- `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID`: Spotify API client ID
   161→- `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET`: Spotify API client secret
   162→- `DEEZER_ARL`: Deezer authentication token (optional - can be auto-detected)
   163→
   164→Configuration (Priority: CLI flags > Environment variables > Default values):
   165→- `GOFI_OUTPUT_DIR`: Default download directory (default: "./downloads")
   166→- `GOFI_QUALITY`: Default audio quality - 1, 3, or 9 (default: 3)
   167→- `GOFI_CONCURRENCY`: Max concurrent downloads - 1 to 10 (default: 5)
   168→- `GOFI_LOG_LEVEL`: Default log level - debug, info, warn, error (default: "info")
   169→
   170→## Important File Paths
   171→
   172→- **Spotify Authentication**: `~/.config/gofi/spotify_token.json` - Stores OAuth2 tokens
   173→- **Environment Variables**: `.env` file in project root directory
   174→- **Binary Location**: `gofi` in project root (excluded from git)
   175→
   176→## Cover Size Settings
   177→
   178→When downloading music, ensure appropriate cover sizes are used based on quality:
   179→- MP3 128kbps (quality=1): 500px
   180→- MP3 320kbps (quality=3): 500px
   181→- FLAC (quality=9): 1000px
   182→
   183→## Testing
   184→
   185→Tests no longer require DEEZER_ARL environment variable. They will:
   186→1. Try to get ARL from environment variable
   187→2. Try to get ARL from browser cookies
   188→3. Skip tests if no valid ARL is available
   189→
   190→Run all tests:
   191→```bash
   192→make test
   193→```
   194→
   195→Run specific tests:
   196→```bash
   197→go test -v ./path/to/package -run TestName
   198→```
   199→
   200→Current test coverage focuses on:
   201→- URL handling and parsing
   202→- API client functionality
   203→- Metadata management
   204→- Browser cookie extraction
   205→- ARL token validation
   206→
   207→## CI/CD
   208→
   209→### GitHub Actions Workflows
   210→
   211→1. **test.yml**: Runs on all pushes and PRs to main
   212→   - Sets up Go 1.23
   213→   - Runs all tests (no longer needs DEEZER_ARL secret)
   214→   
   215→2. **release.yml**: Triggered by version tags (e.g., v1.0.0)
   216→   - Builds binaries for multiple platforms:
   217→     - macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon)
   218→     - Linux (AMD64 and ARM64)
   219→     - Windows (AMD64)
   220→   - Injects version number into binaries
   221→   - Creates GitHub release with all binaries
   222→
   223→## Recent Improvements
   224→
   225→1. **Automatic ARL Detection**: 
   226→   - No manual token configuration needed
   227→   - Supports multiple browsers
   228→   - Secure cookie extraction with proper decryption
   229→
   230→2. **Installation Scripts**:
   231→   - Platform detection and automatic binary selection
   232→   - Proper permission handling
   233→   - PATH management on Windows
   234→
   235→3. **Build System**:
   236→   - Version injection during build
   237→   - Multiple installation targets
   238→   - Development-friendly symlink option
   239→
   240→4. **Testing**:
   241→   - Tests work without environment variables
   242→   - Better error handling for invalid tokens
   243→   - Graceful test skipping
   244→
   245→5. **Error Handling**:
   246→   - Improved error messages throughout
   247→   - Better handling of API responses
   248→   - Retry logic for network failures
   249→
   250→6. **Concurrent Downloads**:
   251→   - Configurable concurrency (1-10 threads)
   252→   - Applies to albums and playlists
   253→   - Thread-safe progress display
   254→   - Default: 5 concurrent downloads
   255→
   256→## Development Tips
   257→
   258→1. Use `make install-dev` during development to create a symlink that updates automatically
   259→2. The `gofi` binary is git-ignored, so it won't be committed
   260→3. Version is automatically set from git tags during build
   261→4. Tests will skip if no valid ARL is available (from env or cookies)
   262→5. Always clean ARL tokens to remove control characters before use
   263→
   264→## Current Status
   265→
   266→The project now includes:
   267→- Full Spotify integration alongside Deezer support
   268→- Automatic URL detection for both Spotify and Deezer URLs
   269→- Beautiful CLI interface with progress bars and colored output
   270→- Smart file management that skips already downloaded files
   271→- Improved error handling and user feedback
